purpose: Define the field-level checks required before an operator parameter set can count as locked evidence for an accepted delta_uet_or_ci operator.

required_lock_rules.requirement: At least one parameter set must be present before PROV-02 can be satisfied.
Every parameter set must identify operator_id=delta_uet_or_ci and a permitted operator class.
Every parameter must be typed, unit-tagged, source-tagged, and carry an uncertainty or explicit noncomputability reason.
The parameter set must be locked before holdout or CHIANTI rows are evaluated.
Holdout and CHIANTI rows must be forbidden parameter sources.

blocked_claims: an empty parameter_sets array is a locked accepted operator
diagnostic quantum-defect parameters satisfy delta_uet_or_ci parameter provenance
holdout or CHIANTI rows may set operator parameters
claim_boundary: This preflight manifest defines acceptance checks for future operator parameters. It does not create a parameter set or accept an operator.
